headline: CCSA names inaugural International CCUS Awards winners (Porthos, NZT Power)
summary: The UK Carbon Capture & Storage Association held its first International CCUS Awards in London on 13 October 2026; winners included the Netherlands' Porthos project and the UK's NZT Power gas-fired capture project.
co2crc_note: Industry-recognition event; a soft signal of European CCS project maturity, limited direct CO2CRC relevance.

headline: Cheshire East Council unanimously objects to Peak Cluster CO2 pipeline
summary: Cheshire East Council unanimously passed a motion formally opposing the proposed Peak Cluster CO2 pipeline (a Nationally Significant Infrastructure Project at pre-application stage), demanding independent environmental, hydrological, economic and safety assessments of the route before any development consent determination.
co2crc_note: Community-consent flashpoint for CO2 transport infrastructure; relevant to CO2CRC social-licence and stakeholder-engagement lessons for pipeline/storage siting.
